title: Standing seeded mutation fuzz against the original (cargo xtask fuzz)
scope: Turn the 2026-11-02 PLY/STL audit harness into a repeatable command: a seed and unit name generate mutated inputs (truncation at every byte, byte substitution/insert/delete, header-token dictionary, count and type edits, Unicode and encoding edge cases, random model-based files), run the original and Rust on independent copies and compare success, full error and progress text and output bytes. Covers every parser/import unit; divergences and host-limit refusals are reported in separate classes.
acceptance: Command runs a named parser unit at a given seed and case count, prints case/divergence counts and writes minimal reproducers outside the repo; a deliberately wrong Rust value is reported as a divergence.
PLY and STL run reproduces the 2026-11-02 audit result (zero divergences after PR #33) from the committed generator and records the seed set; OBJ is added in the same PR or the next.
A scheduled hosted job runs fresh seeds; findings become files under plan/findings and a failing regression test, never a looser comparison.

evidence.summary: ply seeds 1,7,99 x 10000 and stl seeds 1,7,99 x 30000: 0 divergences; selfcheck seed 1 x 300 reports 194 (stl) and 108 (ply) divergences

open_items: OBJ generator and comparison are not added; PLY and STL only.
Scheduled hosted job not added (touches .github; one PR at a time).
Host-limit refusals (H1 to H3) and original timeouts are counted in their own classes and remain an owner decision.
